mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：【分级产品取“产品名称+子产品名称”；普通产品取“产品名称”】 PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） SETDATE：产品成立日期 */ SELECT RPI.PROD_ID innerProdId, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||'（'||RPI.PROD_ID||'）' ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END titleName, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI.PROD_NAME ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END prodName, RPI.PROD_RE regCode, RPI.SET_DATE setDate FROM REP_PROD_INFO RPI /*查询普通产品或者母产品数据 P_PROD_ID:母产品代码：当为子产品时填写母产品代码。普通产品为自己的产品代码。母产品为空*/ LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RPI2 ON RPI.P_PROD_ID = RPI2.PROD_ID AND RPI2.STATUS = 'E' WHERE RPI.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND RPI.STATUS = 'E'

SELECT DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE, DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE, DPP.HOLD_DAYS FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP ON DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) where INFO.STATUS = 'E' and DPP.DATA_STATUS = 'E' AND INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE = TO_DATE(#{announceDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP1 WHERE DPP1.PROD_ID = DPP.PROD_ID AND DPP1.OPERATION_START_DATE = DPP.AUTO_REDEEM_DATE AND DPP1.DATA_STATUS='E' )
AND DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{announceDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
order by DPP.OPERATION_START_DATE desc
